_note: Side quests. A villager offers one when the condition in 'giver' holds for them at dawn. 'need' is goods the player hands over (they go to the giver); 'kill' names a target ('robber': the bandit who robbed the giver). 'reward' is coins the giver pays from their own purse (all they have, if less). Lines are spoken by the giver: {need} is replaced by the goods asked for, {target} by the target's name. docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md, 'Side quests'.

quests.title: Ore for the forge
quests.offer: My forge goes cold without iron. Bring me {need} and I'll pay you twenty coins.
quests.waiting: Still no ore? The fire won't wait forever.
quests.thanks: Good iron, that. Here's your pay, as I said.

quests.title: Wood for the hearth
quests.offer: I can't cook on a cold stove. Fetch me {need} and there's ten coins in it.
quests.thanks: That'll keep the pot boiling. Thank you.

quests.title: A new axe
quests.offer: My axe broke on a knot and I can't work without one. Bring me {need} and I'll pay what it's worth.
quests.waiting: No axe yet? Every day without one is a day without pay.
quests.thanks: A fine edge. Back to the trees for me.

quests.title: Food for the family
quests.offer: There's little in our pot and the young ones are hungry. Could you bring {need}? It's not much I can give you.
quests.waiting: The children ask when you'll come.
quests.thanks: Bless you. They'll sleep with full bellies tonight.

quests.title: Bandit trouble
quests.offer: {target} robbed me on the road. Deal with that thief and I'll give you what I can.
quests.thanks: So {target} is gone. I can walk the road again. Take this.
